newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Tel to make "important announcement".
newsitem.headline: HK Tel to make "important announcement".

text.p: Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd said on Friday it would make an "important announcement" at a press conference in Hong Kong scheduled for 1515 GMT.
In London, Cable & Wireless Plc announced it would sell 5.5 percent of Hongkong Telecom to state-owned China Telecom for HK$14.25 per share in a deal worth a total of 726 million sterling.
C&W owned about 59 percent of Hongkong Telecom prior to the deal.
Shares in Hongkong Telecom hit record highs on the Hong Kong stock market on Friday, due to speculation about China's Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications taking a stake in the company.
Hongkong Telecom soared to an all-time high of HK$19.25 then eased slightly to close HK$1.90 higher at HK$19.00.
